name: genudo
description: Genudo — the enterprise operating platform for autonomous AI Employees (Sales, Customer Support, Rose Quality Control & Operations, and WhatsApp Campaign Sender) across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, and Web. Integrated with Zoho Desk, Zapier, Webhooks, and live Lovable dashboards. This plugin builds, edits, automates, and analyzes them from ChatGPT and Codex with 32 skills and the Genudo connector.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy and manage autonomous AI Employees across WhatsApp & Social Channels
interface.longDescription: Genudo is the enterprise operating platform for autonomous AI Employees across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, and Web. Manage your digital workforce from one inbox and analytics dashboard: deploy 24/7 AI Sales Agents, AI Customer Support Agents (with Zoho Desk / Zendesk integration), Rose Quality Control & Operations (auditing staff WhatsApp lines, transcribing voice notes, tracking response latency), and the official WhatsApp Campaign Sender. This plugin gives ChatGPT and Codex 32 skills and full MCP connectivity to audit, author, automate, and build live custom dashboards.
defaultPrompt: Introduce me to the GenuDo AI Workforce and audit my active workspace.
How do I connect Rose to audit my team's WhatsApp response times?
Build a high-converting WhatsApp sales agent for my business.
Deploy a live, real-time GenuDo performance dashboard for my team.
